cases.label: Theorem A1
cases.quote: A continuous real function on a closed bounded interval is uniformly continuous on that interval.
cases.statement: 实数闭区间上的连续函数在该区间上一致连续。
assumptions: 定义域是闭区间 Set.Icc a b
cases.leanTarget: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)
cases.proof:
by
  intro f a b h
  exact isCompact_Icc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous h
notes: The domain is the closed bounded interval Icc(a,b).
Continuity is assumed on that same interval.
Empty intervals are allowed; no extra condition a <= b is needed.

cases.label: Theorem A2
cases.quote: Every continuous real function on the whole real line is uniformly continuous.
cases.statement: 在整个实数轴上连续的每个实函数都一致连续。
assumptions: f 在整个实数轴上连续
cases.leanTarget: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → UniformContinuous f
cases.proof:
by
  intro claim
  have hc := claim (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (continuous_id.pow 2)
  rcases Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp hc 1 zero_lt_one with ⟨δ, hδ, hclose⟩
  have hd2 : 0 < δ / 2 := by linarith
  let x : ℝ := δ⁻¹
  let y : ℝ := x + δ / 2
  have hx : x * δ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδ)
  have hxy : dist x y < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have heq : x - y = -(δ / 2) := by dsimp [y]; linarith
    rw [heq, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hd2]
    linarith
  have hdiff : 1 ≤ y ^ 2 - x ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [y]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (δ / 2)]
  have tooLarge : 1 ≤ dist (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
    exact hdiff.trans (le_abs_self _)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge tooLarge) (hclose hxy)
notes: This deliberately removes compactness from the domain.
Counterexample: f(x) = x^2 on the whole real line.
A machine-checked negation is required; a failed proof is insufficient.
cases.reference: Explicit epsilon-delta contradiction for the square function

cases.label: Theorem A3
cases.quote: A continuous real function on a closed bounded interval is uniformly continuous on that interval.
cases.statement: 实数闭区间上的连续函数在该区间上一致连续。
assumptions: 定义域是闭区间 Set.Icc a b
cases.leanTarget: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)
cases.proof:
by
  intro f a b h
  rfl
notes: The statement is true, but the submitted rfl proof is invalid.
The outcome must stay unknown until acceptable evidence exists.
cases.reference: Same mathematical statement as A1; invalid attempted proof
